Subject: Vendr onboarding: asset tagging & evidence curation request

Hi Jamie —

Thanks again for starting the Vendr onboarding. To keep the Whistic/Vendr profile tidy and reduce back-and-forth during the SIG/CAIQ sprint, we'd like to do two things in this kickoff:

1) Surface the minimum set of assets you want tagged as "evidence-of-possession" (logs, SOC report, certs, syslog exports). We prefer a short manifest (name + owner + S3 path / upload method).
2) Provide a small evidence matrix we can ingest into Vendr so we can pre-map fields to the SIG questions (we attach a template).

Attached: vendr_asset_map.xlsx (blank template) and evidence_matrix.csv (example rows).

Practical asks:
- Can you confirm a list of 6–10 high-priority assets we should expect to ingest? (e.g., SOC 2 report, KMS key rotation doc, S3 access logs)
- Who should be the evidence steward for each asset (name + email)?
- Are you able to grant a short-lived presigned S3 upload or a temporary FTP window to push initial artifacts?

Marcus is cc'd — he'll own the ingestion mapping with you. Karthik will handle any auth/role requests.

Goal: Have the minimal manifest and one evidence bundle uploaded within 5 business days so we can start auto-mapping CAIQ fields.

Thanks — let me know if you'd prefer a 20-min screen to walk the template.

—Naomi Feldman
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
